description: This Java source file defines the class EnforcerRetriever, which is responsible for retrieving Enforcer objects and associated metadata using various caches. It provides methods to retrieve enforcers by entity key or enforcer key, handling cache lookups asynchronously via CompletionStage. It also logs cache misses and errors related to missing caches. The class appears to be a core part of an enforcement or access control mechanism within the Eclipse Ditto framework, dealing with cache management and retrieval logic.
